data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 面包店的黄豆粉面包
data.description: 面包店玻璃柜前，她整个人贴上去盯着新出炉的黄豆粉面包，眼睛亮得像发现宝物；买到之后当场咬下一大口，幸福到头顶的蝴蝶结都在晃。
data.action: 面包店玻璃柜前，她整个人贴上去盯着新出炉的黄豆粉面包，眼睛亮得像发现宝物
data.promptProse: Tohka leans eagerly toward the bakery glass, violet eyes shining at the tray of freshly baked kinako bread. She takes a delighted first bite of her purchased roll in its paper sleeve, her large hair ribbon lifting with the movement. The medium view includes her neat school collar and the display counter extending behind. Warm shop lighting reveals powder on the bread and reflections on glass, with darker tray undersides.
